summary: Tested Client 360 backend + frontend. Backend pytest 6/6 PASSED (100%): requires_auth (401/403), bogus id (404), cross-advisor isolation (404 for other advisor's client), full shape with all 8 keys + counts dict + 5 arrays + timeline, empty-client zero counts, and aggregation (seeded email+compliance+report via /api/advisor-emails/generate, /api/compliance/generate, /api/reports/generate → counts incremented by 3, timeline sorted DESC by created_at). Frontend: Client 360 page renders correctly when accessed directly at /clients/:id/360 — client-360-page testid present, client-name 'Test Client', all 5 stat tiles (stat-document/report/email/compliance/portfolio_review), 4 Smart Actions, 6 tabs, 'Nothing recorded yet' empty state. Smart Action 'Generate Portfolio Review' is properly disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) when counts.documents===0 and clicking it shows 'Upload documents first' info toast without navigation. Other 3 Smart Actions (Draft Email, New Compliance Record, Build Client Report) navigate correctly to /email-generator, /compliance-notes, /report-builder respectively with ?client_id={id}, and the destination page's [data-testid='select-client'] is preselected to 'Test Client' (text content verified). RoleGate negative test PASSED — individual user (TEST_ind_1779453426@example.com) sees role-gate-blocker with 'Financial Advisors only' message and the client-360-page is NOT rendered. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: /clients route is NOT registered in /app/frontend/src/App.js — only /clients/:clientId/360 exists. Visiting /clients (which ClientsPage.jsx is built for and which Client360's breadcrumb links to via Link to='/clients') results in a blank body (nav + footer only, no clients-page testid, no 'Manage your client profiles' header). This blocks the review-request item 'each client card has a green 360 View button' from being reached via the UI, although clicking the cards in ClientsPage.jsx code would correctly call <Link to=`/clients/${id}/360`> when the route IS registered.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing <Route path="/clients" element={<ClientsPage/>}/> registration. /clients page is unreachable via URL — body renders empty (only top-nav + footer chrome). Breadcrumb 'Clients' link inside Client360 and the redirect targets in ClientProfilePage / SubscriptionSuccessPage all lead to a blank page.

action_items: Register the /clients route in /app/frontend/src/App.js (e.g. <Route path="/clients" element={<ProtectedRoute><RoleGate role="advisor"><ClientsPage/></RoleGate></ProtectedRoute>}/>). Import ClientsPage at top of file. This will unblock the green '360 View' button verification end-to-end as well as the breadcrumb navigation from Client360 back to the list.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/client_360.py: clean implementation — advisor_id scoping on every query, _id excluded via projection, parallel-ish awaits acceptable, timeline correctly sorted DESC, 50-item cap on timeline; per-collection 20-item cap. No N+1 issues.

Client360.jsx: tailwind dynamic class strings like `text-${meta.color}-400`, `bg-${a.color}-500/5` rely on JIT compiling these utilities — risk of purge dropping these in prod build if they aren't safelisted in tailwind.config. Verify all 5 color tokens (sky, emerald, amber, rose, indigo) are in safelist; otherwise stat icon colors / smart action card borders won't render in production.
Client360.jsx: countKey mapping is hardcoded ternary chain (line 170) — readable but fragile if KIND_META keys change. Consider deriving from a single source of truth.

App.js: /clients route missing (CRITICAL). Also note /clients/:clientId/360 is wrapped by RoleGate but NOT GatedCalculator (intentional per request — 360 is a hub, not a premium calculator). However the 4 destination tools ARE all GatedCalculator-gated, so a free-tier advisor clicking a Smart Action will hit a paywall on the destination tool — this is acceptable but may want a 'Premium required' hint on the Smart Actions card to set expectation.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 review items verified, /clients page rendering blocked by missing route)

rca of the issue: Root cause for /clients blank: App.js has <Route path="/clients/:clientId/360" .../> but no <Route path="/clients" .../>. React Router falls through to no matching route, rendering only the top-level layout. Fix: add the route registration with ProtectedRoute + RoleGate(advisor) wrappers and import ClientsPage. Single-line change.
